channel_id.description: Channel identifier identifies the owner maintaining this grouping.
channel_id.rationale: It is metadata and does not grant privileges or expose sensitive configuration

channel_uri.description: A reference to the associated storefront/marketplace.
channel_uri.rationale: It is informational and does not affect security controls

deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.
deletion_policy.rationale: Determines whether Terraform can delete or abandon the resource. Misconfiguration can impact resource integrity or availability by preventing or allowing deletion.

display_name.description: App group name displayed in the UI
display_name.rationale: It has no effect on authentication, authorisation, or resource security.

name.description: Name of the AppGroup. Characters you can use in the name are restricted to: A-Z0-9._-$ %.
name.rationale: Resource identifier only. While important for uniqueness, it does not itself affect security

org_id.description:
The Apigee Organization associated with the Apigee app group,
in the format 'organizations/{{org_name}}'.
org_id.rationale: Identifies the Apigee organization associated with the AppGroup but does not directly configure access control, authentication, authorization, encryption, or other security settings.

status.description: Valid values are active or inactive. Note that the status of the AppGroup should be updated via UpdateAppGroupRequest by setting the action as active or inactive. Possible values: ["active", "inactive"]
status.rationale: Changing this affects whether the AppGroup can be used, impacting access and availability

attributes.name.rationale: The attribute key itself is descriptive and does not have a direct security impact

attributes.value.rationale: Stores user-defined metadata values for the AppGroup and does not directly affect permissions, security configuration, or resource protection.
